messages.subject: Maple Court - draft representations against Notice of Proposal [PRIVILEGED]
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Lorna,

Draft representations attached (v1). Structure: accept Condition 1 (monthly reporting) for a defined period; resist Condition 2 (admissions restriction) as disproportionate given the breach is remedied; and offer a narrower fallback (short notice of admissions to Ferndale only) if CQC insists. We'll attach the action-plan tracker and external audit as evidence.

Deadline is 22 May. Comments welcome.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Maple Court - draft representations against Notice of Proposal [PRIVILEGED]
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

After the call, I've revised the representations - redline attached. Key changes: I've stretched the offered reporting period on Condition 1 from six to nine months (a credible give that strengthens our resistance to Condition 2), and softened the fallback on admissions from '48 hours' notice for three months' to 'five working days' notice for two months', which reads as more workable and proportionate. This is the version I propose we file.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
